mentions.name: DB Pro
mentions.description: A cross-platform database management app that lets users browse, query, and manage SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, and more from a single native interface. The desktop app acts as the execution engine so data never leaves the user's own infrastructure, and ongoing development is shared through YouTube devlogs that have built a community of ~1,400 subscribers.
